Name: PRidea Digital
Company description: PRidea as a brand was established in 2002 (tradesman) when in 2008 it changed the form to SRO (LLC).  PRidea's main operations is split between Events and Digital. Digital division is oriented mainly on being sales representative of the multinational network Crimtan (www.crimtan.com) and additional services, such as social media marketing, PPC campaigns etc.
